description: Read an article of an official French code — Code civil, Code pénal, Code du travail, Code de commerce, Code général des impôts, Code de la santé publique and the other codes in force — by code and article number, from DILA's consolidated LEGI base (the text Légifrance publishes). Returns the text in force today (or on `date`), its dates of entry into force and end, its place in the code (livre/titre/chapitre), the NOTA, and every version of the article with dates. Use for "what does article 1240 of the Code civil say", "Code du travail L1221-1", "article 121-3 du Code pénal".

code.description: The code: its title ("Code civil", "Code du travail", "Code général des impôts"), a short form ("civil", "travail", "CGI", "CPP", "CSP"), or its Légifrance cid (LEGITEXT000006070721).

date.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD: return the version in force on that date instead of today.

name: fr_code_article
title: Fr Code Article
